patch_description: The NIS-driven process-noise multiplier can inflate Q up to ~51× q_base on innovation bursts, leaking noise into the velocity state and causing spurious slope reversals (41 slope changes, false reversal penalty 36.4 — the rank-predicting metric). We cap the multiplier at 4× and raise q_base so genuine turns still track while noise-driven velocity jitter is suppressed. Since I could not match the full expression verbatim, I target the smaller, distinctive fragments containing the NIS clamp and the q_base definition.
